mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_itinerary_place ( project_id, day, order_no, place_id ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{day}, #{orderNo}, #{placeId} )
mapper.select: SELECT pip.order_no AS "order", p.place_id AS placeId, p.place_name AS placeName, p.place_address AS address, p.place_type AS placeType, p.latitude AS latitude, p.longitude AS longitude, p.thumbnail as thumbnail, pip.day as day FROM project_itinerary_place pip JOIN project_place p ON pip.place_id = p.place_id WHERE pip.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY pip.day, pip.order_no
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_itinerary_place WHERE place_id = #{placeId})
